h2o-lightning-31b-v1.3.4.author: H2O.ai (paid evaluation, PUBLIC visibility)

cost.basis: GPU-time estimate from v1.8.0: one monthly-rented RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, USD 1.5235/hour; average load 70%. Architecture: dense gemma, 31B active parameters; throughput 10106.516129 tokens/s (architecture-class calibration, efficient-engine prefill). GPU-time cost USD 0.0212260058867847/1,000; old list-price estimate USD 0.0321852518468771/1,000 (google/gemma-4-31b-it at USD 0.09/M input and USD 0.34/M output). Applied min(old list-price estimate, GPU-time cost) = USD 0.0212260058867847/1,000. Estimated, not a bill.

h2o-lightning-31b-v1.3.4.disclosure: Paid public evaluation. Measured on the 27 Oct draw on an evaluator-owned Verda GPU VM (RTX PRO 6000), offline with the author's serving stack at the pinned commit. Each scored stage is one fresh compile read once (no best-of). Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers. Second H2O-family model on this draw (after H2O-Lightning-4B v1.4.1); no shared weights. The temperatures and yes/no floor were fitted on v1.3.0's weights from Decision Index 0.3 public per-row reads (the release keeps them). The router head was fitted on HLE-style sets, with JevBench's public 231 items read as held-out. The determinism figure describes the preparation compile only; each scored stage is one fresh compile read once.

draw.ci_basis: measured on the draw before equating
draw.label: Third regular draw

h2o-lightning-31b-v1.3.4.endpoint_condition: Evaluator-owned Verda GPU VM (RTX PRO 6000), offline container (--network none; lo only), author's serving stack at model commit c35ed9505f6744770dc0d74bd3f468791a7984af. Unmodified serve.sh --profile two-way, one vLLM 0.30.0 engine with h2oai/vllm overlay a36449a18b4465b4f70fa078f5403032de414de8. Online FP8 W8A8 from BF16 weights, TRITON_ATTN; max model length 131072, state budget 126976, two-way window 8192, selector v2 with automatic one-way fallback for the record/window or summed prompt threshold 4096. One read, readout_orders=1; AR and router off. PyTorch 2.13.0, transformers 5.20.0, torchcodec 0.17.0. Each scored stage is one fresh compile read once (no best-of); determinism is assessed only within the public preparation compile. Standard self-hosted x2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment.
